name: identity-decoy
description: Emulates Active Directory LDAP, LDAPS and RDP (NLA/CredSSP) services to capture credential guessing, directory enumeration and NTLM authentication attempts. Every login fails.
author: Doppel
documentation: Runs as UID 0 with every capability dropped except NET_BIND_SERVICE (needed for LDAP port 389 and LDAPS port 636 in host networking; Docker grants added capabilities only to root). Read-only filesystem, no-new-privileges. Generates a fresh ephemeral self-signed ECDSA P-256 TLS certificate in memory at startup for the persona hostname (never written to disk), used for LDAPS and RDP NLA. Passwords and NetNTLMv2 responses are reported as an HMAC with the node's capture key by default (TS_PASSWORD_CAPTURE=hash) so the Hub can match planted honeytokens without storing plaintext. Per-protocol enabled_key flags ensure disabled protocols do not hold ports.

config.name: TS_LDAP_PORT
config.description: TCP port for the LDAP decoy

config.name: TS_ENABLE_LDAPS
config.description: Enable the LDAPS (LDAP over TLS) decoy listener

config.name: TS_LDAPS_PORT
config.description: TCP port for the LDAPS decoy

config.name: TS_RDP_PORT
config.description: TCP port for the RDP decoy

config.name: TS_DOMAIN_DNS
config.description: DNS domain name advertised in LDAP RootDSE, NTLM target info and TLS certificate

config.name: TS_DOMAIN_NETBIOS
config.description: NetBIOS domain name advertised in NTLM target information

config.name: TS_HOSTNAME
config.description: Short host name of the domain controller persona

config.name: TS_OS_BUILD
config.description: Windows OS major.minor.build version advertised in NTLM CHALLENGE messages

config.name: TS_PASSWORD_CAPTURE
config.description: hash: HMAC with the node capture key; plain: clear text; none: not captured

config.name: TS_MAX_CONNS
config.description: Concurrent connections across all enabled listeners

config.name: TS_EVENT_COOLDOWN_SEC
config.description: Event rate-limit window in seconds per source (0 = report every attempt)

triggers.name: ldap_query
triggers.description: LDAP search query (RootDSE or directory enumeration)

triggers.name: ldap_connection
triggers.description: LDAP connection closed without an authentication attempt or query

triggers.name: ldaps_login
triggers.description: LDAPS authentication attempt (simple bind or NTLM)

triggers.name: ldaps_query
triggers.description: LDAPS search query (RootDSE or directory enumeration)

triggers.name: ldaps_connection
triggers.description: LDAPS connection closed without an authentication attempt or query
